column3: “Wickedness” is rendered “iniquity,” and “counsel counsel of evil” as “give evil advice.”
NASB takes “not near” as a question (“Is not the time near”) and supplies “This city.” The Hebrew could also mean “It is not near.”
“Thoughts of your spirit” is rendered “your thoughts.”
“On the territory of Israel” is rendered “to the border of Israel.”
“People of your redemption” is rendered “fellow exiles,” following the LXX; NASB also has “relatives.”
“One heart” follows the Hebrew; some manuscripts read “another heart.” “Within you” is rendered “within them.”
